purpose: Frozen corpus of REAL Agent2Agent (A2A) v1.0 wire examples extracted programmatically (byte-faithful) from the official specification, used to prove the AshA2A.Protocol.JSON codec accepts every one into its corresponding struct. Members the codec rejects are pinned as codec_gap findings with the exact decode error; members the codec accepts must survive decode -> encode -> decode with struct equality.

expect.decode: The real codec decode path must accept the member into its struct and survive decode -> encode -> decode struct-equality round trip.
expect.codec_gap: The real codec decode path demonstrably rejects a spec-real member, or no decode path exists. The exact decode error / probe outcome is pinned here as a regression spec; the member the codec does not accept is named in the finding. No lib/ code was edited to make these pass.

decode_values.jsonrpc_error: no decode path exists (Error is encode-only) - asserted via codec_gap probes

conventions.deviations: Minimal normalization applied ONLY where an example is demonstrably pseudo-code at the syntax level. Each deviation is listed per-entry in `deviations`. Everything else is verbatim.

excluded_as_pseudo_code: L2282 JSON-RPC generic envelope with /* method-specific parameters */ comment
L2312 SendMessageResponse envelope with /* comment */ result body (no concrete member to decode)
HTTP example L848 push-notification webhook template with /* StreamResponse object */ comments
L1570 ListTasksSuccess example whose tasks array is `/* ... additional tasks */` (the page envelope also has no codec struct - noted in findings)
L1859 extended-card response with /* Extended skills */ comment
L2960/L2971 message:stream request/response templates with /* comment */ bodies
L1832/L2039/L2064 capability-extension partial snippets (AgentCapabilities fragments, not full members)
L2775/L2822/L2880/L2886/L2928 REST-binding illustrative fragments already captured or template-only
findings_summary: F1: spec Message examples without messageId (L1087 extensions/metadata example; the L1406 input-required status.message) are rejected by the codec: {:error, {:missing_field, "messageId"}}.

F2: JSON-RPC error-response envelopes (L2469, suite L2493) have no decode path into %AshA2A.Protocol.JSONRPC.Error{} - Error implements to_map/1 (encode) only; a proxy/relay cannot decode a peer's error envelope.

F3 (silent drop, decodes fine): AgentCard wire key `securityRequirements` (L2114 GeoSpatial card) is not read by decode_agent_card/1 - it only reads `security`, so the member decodes but security requirements are silently dropped and never re-encoded.

F4 (silent drop, decodes fine): per-skill `examples`, `inputModes`, `outputModes` and other card/skill extras are dropped by the card decoder; struct equality still holds because the first decode already dropped them.

F5: the spec's L1008 AgentCard example omits `version` even though a2a.proto marks AgentCard.version REQUIRED - the codec rejects the spec's own example with {:error, {:missing_field, "version"}}. The codec matches the spec's schema here; the spec example is internally non-conformant.

examples.source: specification.md L1008 - AgentCard example (Research Assistant Agent)
deviations: Spec snippet has a trailing comma after supportedInterfaces[0].protocolVersion (pseudo-code at the syntax level); removed so the member parses as JSON. No other change.
examples.finding: The codec requires the `version` member on AgentCard, which the proto marks REQUIRED (a2a.proto AgentCard.version field_behavior REQUIRED), but the spec's own L1008 example omits it - the spec example is non-conformant to the spec's own schema. The member the codec does not accept is the card as printed. Exact decode error: {:error, {:missing_field, "version"}}.

examples.source: specification.md L2469 - JSON-RPC error response (-32602 with google.rpc.BadRequest fieldViolations)
examples.finding: The codec has no decode path for a JSON-RPC error envelope into %AshA2A.Protocol.JSONRPC.Error{}: Error implements to_map/1 (encode) only, so a client/relay cannot structurally admit a peer's spec-real error envelope. Pinned probes of the real paths: JSONRPC.Request.parse/1 rejects the envelope with {:error, %JSONRPC.Error{code: -32600}} (invalid_request - it is not a request), and AshA2A.Protocol.JSON.decode/2 on :event returns {:error, _}.

fieldViolations.description: At least one part is required
